question: Two circles of radii 15 and 18 cm touch each other externally. What is the length (in cm) of the direct common tangent to the two circles?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Direct common tangent = 2 × √(r₁ × r₂) = 2 × √(15 × 18) = 6√30 cm **∴ The correct answer is 6√30 cm.**
